verdict.rationale: Clara documents programmatic transaction retrieval via its API and an official MCP for AI assistants to review transactions. Its reconciliation guide documents categorizing transactions with labels that attach GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs, which covers pulling and writing coding back. missing for 10: a documented filter for uncoded transactions, policy-flag proposal or write-back, a review/approval queue for agent-pushed coding, explicit MCP tools for labeling, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review

citations.quote: Pull all transactions for a billing period, match them to the billing statement, categorize with labels, and export to your accounting system.
Labels let you attach GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs to transactions
Use Clara MCP when the user wants an AI assistant to inspect or act on Clara data in natural language, such as listing cards, reviewing transactions, switching companies, or locking a card
issue and manage cards, retrieve transactions, handle users, process invoices
